title: Decide whether work can start
prompt: assigned and blocked are supplied bools, and minutes is a supplied whole number. Declare a bool named ready. It is true only when the task is assigned, is not blocked, and has more than 0 minutes.
hints: How many separate facts must all be true?
Join facts that must all hold with &&. Flip blocked with !.
Combine assigned, !blocked and minutes > 0 with && in one expression.
checkLabels: ready must be true only for an assigned task that is not blocked and has more than 0 minutes.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Uses or where every condition must hold.

feedback: Take the failing case and work out each of the three facts on its own. ready is true only when all three are true.
